اصطبنا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَبَنَا (iṣṭabanā) /isˤ.tˤa.ba.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اِصْطَبَنَّا (iṣṭabannā) /isˤ.tˤa.ban.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اُصْطُبِنَا (uṣṭubinā) /usˤ.tˤu.bi.naː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# اُصْطُبِنَّا (uṣṭubinnā) /usˤ.tˤu.bin.naː/: first-person pl
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
